items.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손

assessments.rationale: No restatement, auditor dispute, material-control failure or comparable integrity event was identified in reviewed filings.
ALAB is strongly net cash and operating-cash-flow positive; ordinary survival does not depend on external financing.
Near-term diluted-share growth is around the rubric's 3% threshold and SBC is material. Persistence is not yet established, so the long-duration veto remains under review rather than confirmed.
Share growth is currently modest relative to business growth, although SBC and customer warrants require continued monitoring.
Production revenue, quantified system-performance improvements and high gross margins show genuine customer value rather than subsidy-led growth.
Triple-digit revenue growth, 73.3% GAAP gross margin and production deployments demonstrate paid customer value.
Revenue, operating profit and cash flow have improved rapidly alongside R&D investment; no evidence shows incremental returns structurally below the cost of capital.
Current evidence shows expanding product breadth, design wins and high-margin revenue rather than persistent moat contraction.
